_about: Hand review of run-v3-qwen3-8b. The automatic checks in inputs.json are keyword-based; a reviewer read every answer. Entries here override the automatic result.

T01.note: Hand review: answer is wrong. It used SW Bay of Bengal chlorophyll, called the species 'unspecified' and reported r=0.016; the automatic check passed only because the word 'correlation' appears. Earlier runs of the same question were correct, so the result is not stable.

T04.note: Hand review: bullets list the flagged months exactly, but the lead paragraph merges them into ranges that include months that were not flagged (e.g. '2015-08 to 2015-12' includes 2015-10 and 2015-11).

T12.note: Hand review: invents a 2030 estimate ('198,260 tonnes in 2030'), which is actually the 2024 value. The automatic regex missed it because the number comes before '2030'.
